$$

$$
{D}^{T}=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 4\end{bmatrix}
$$

The true statements are:
